articles.author: Julia Fioretti, Manuel Baigorri, Anthony Hughes
articles.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus IPO Collapses as AI Valuation Concerns Grow - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: Firmus Grid Ltd. abandoned its attempt at one of Australia’s biggest-ever initial public offerings, after the Nvidia Corp.-backed data center company failed to lure global investors who’ve grown increasingly skittish over frothy AI valuations.
